actionConfiguration.body:
SELECT
    di.id AS documentItemId,
    di.document_id AS documentId,
    di.line_no AS lineNo,

    p.id AS productId,
    p.code AS productCode,
    p.name AS productName,
    p.barcode AS barcode,

    COALESCE(di.description, p.name) AS description,

    u.code AS unitCode,

    CASE
      WHEN d.document_type = 'CREDIT_NOTE' THEN -ABS(COALESCE(di.quantity, 0))
      ELSE COALESCE(di.quantity, 0)
    END AS quantity,

    COALESCE(di.unit_price, 0) AS unitPrice,
    COALESCE(di.discount_amount, 0) AS discountAmount,

    COALESCE(tr.rate, 0) AS taxRate,

    CASE
      WHEN d.document_type = 'CREDIT_NOTE' THEN -ABS(COALESCE(di.line_subtotal, COALESCE(di.quantity, 0) * COALESCE(di.unit_price, 0), 0))
      ELSE COALESCE(di.line_subtotal, COALESCE(di.quantity, 0) * COALESCE(di.unit_price, 0), 0)
    END AS lineSubtotal,

    CASE
      WHEN d.document_type = 'CREDIT_NOTE' THEN -ABS(COALESCE(di.tax_amount, 0))
      ELSE COALESCE(di.tax_amount, 0)
    END AS taxAmount,

    CASE
      WHEN d.document_type = 'CREDIT_NOTE' THEN -ABS(COALESCE(di.line_total, 0))
      ELSE COALESCE(di.line_total, 0)
    END AS lineTotal,

    di.note
FROM documents d
JOIN document_items di ON di.document_id = d.id
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = di.product_id
LEFT JOIN units_of_measure u ON u.id = di.unit_id
LEFT JOIN tax_rates tr ON tr.id = di.tax_rate_id
WHERE d.id = {{ Number((this.params && this.params.documentId) || appsmith.store.salesSelectedDocumentId || 0) }}
  AND d.company_id = {{ Number(appsmith.store.companyId || 1) }}
  AND d.document_type IN ('QUOTE', 'SALES_ORDER', 'DELIVERY_NOTE', 'SALES_INVOICE', 'CREDIT_NOTE')
ORDER BY di.line_no;
